name: OpenFillAction
description: Dutch-auction swap: offers its whole input for a flat demandPerFill of the demanded token, and any filler can take it. It has no cap of its own: feed it from a stream with a maxBudget, which sets the worst price (demandPerFill over the most the node can receive). Restarts its budget when the manager changes demandPerFill, so it needs CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID on that budget.

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.description: The flow's stream budget, restarted when the demand changes. In a recipe: ref(i) of the budget component.

inputs.name: demandedToken
inputs.description: The token the DAO must receive. 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

inputs.name: demandPerFill
inputs.description: How much of the demanded token must come back per fill.
